# Executive Summary

Revenue grew **18%** year over year to $42.1M, driven by enterprise renewals. See [the dashboard](https://example.com/q3) for detail.

# Key Findings

- Enterprise renewals reached 94%
  - Mid-market renewals held at 88%
- Churn fell to 2.1%
- Gross margin improved to 71%

# Recommendations

1. Expand the enterprise sales team
2. Invest in onboarding automation
   - Self-serve setup
   - Guided migrations
3. Review mid-market pricing

# Outlook

We expect continued growth in Q4, subject to macro conditions.
